newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy MIF 6 pct June future seen listed next week.
newsitem.headline: Italy MIF 6 pct June future seen listed next week.

text.p: A new Btp futures contract with a six percent coupon will probably be listed on the Italian MIF futures market by the end of next week, market sources said.
The Treasury is expected to give its approval by then.

The management committee of the Italian government bond secondary market (MTS) and the MIF futures market said on Thursday night it was halving to six percent from 12 percent the nominal coupon on the Btp government bond futures contract.
It announced the decision in a statement after a meeting with representatives of the Treasury, the Bank of Italy and the Consob stock market regulatory authority.
The new contract will be traded alongside the 12-percent June contract already listed. But from the next future contract, September, only one six percent contract will be listed.
Sources at the London Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) said LIFFE was considering whether to modify specifications of contracts but had not yet made a decision.
